items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: It was our band along with a former movie singer and actor, the guy that did -- was famous for Donkey Serenade, Allen Jones.

ctx.x: Good, good. Woody, what about the principal radio shows you had in earlier days? You had a couple of them, didn't you, cigarettes and Wildroot Cream Oil and --

Yeah. Well, the first one, actually, was -- the first one that we had a series, a matter of weeks, was Old Gold cigarettes, and it was an incongruous mating, I think. It was our band along with a former movie singer and actor, the guy that did -- was famous for Donkey Serenade, Allen Jones.
